summary: Completed targeted backend + UI verification for permanent empty-category cleanup controls using only safe dry-run cleanup calls; schedule state was restored after mutation tests.

minor.issue: Response exposes `removed_categories` + `would_delete` but does not expose a `candidates` field name as requested in requirement wording.

issues: Date/time control uses browser-native `datetime-local` picker instead of a custom calendar/time component; UX varies by browser/OS.

action_items: If product requirement is strict, add `candidates` alias in dry-run response (or update requirement/docs to `removed_categories`).
Consider replacing native datetime input with consistent calendar/time picker component in Categories scheduler UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Permanent cleanup implementation is hard delete: `_purge_empty_categories` computes empty category docs by comparing `categories.slug` against `products.distinct('category')`, then runs `db.categories.delete_many(...)` (no soft-delete fields).
Manual cleanup endpoint (`POST /api/categories/cleanup-empty`) calls `_run_category_cleanup('manual')` by default, while `?dry_run=true` returns preview only and skips deletion.

Scheduler loop `_category_cleanup_scheduler_loop` checks due schedules every 60s and calls `_run_category_cleanup('scheduled')`; recurrence handling advances `next_run_at` for daily/weekly and disables once-only schedules (`enabled=false`, `next_run_at=null`).
seed_data_creation: Temporary QA category created during dry-run verification and removed at test end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Did not execute destructive cleanup endpoint without dry_run=true on shared live DB. Schedule mutation tests used fixture-based Mongo restore of `category_cleanup_schedule` singleton after each mutation case.
rca of the issue: Requirement/API naming drift: implementation and tests use `removed_categories` for dry-run candidate rows, while requirement text states `candidates`. Functional behavior is correct (preview + no delete), but contract naming may cause downstream assertion or client mismatch if `candidates` is expected literally.
